name: primekgagent
description: Download the PrimeKG precision medicine knowledge graph once from Harvard Dataverse and query it on this computer: node lookup, neighbours and short paths between drugs, diseases, genes and phenotypes. No key needed.

env_vars.description: Optional folder for the local PrimeKG copy (about 700 MB). Default: a folder beside Biorouter's data, kept across updates.

skills.name: primekg-knowledge-graph
skills.description: How to call PrimeKGAgent's tools: download PrimeKG once, then look up nodes, neighbours and short paths in the local copy.
